# WSL World for DSH

**`dsh-wsl` is a complete WSL execution world for DeepSeek Harness, not a
`wsl_*` tool set.** One DS

H session runs its bash, filesystem tools, terminal,
search and `@` references inside a local WSL di

stribution — Linux paths, Linux
tools, no Windows/9P indirection.

- npm: `@chronosun/dsh-wsl`
- plugin-market index: `https://chronossun.github.io/dsh-wsl/index.json`

- package source: `pkg/`
- market index source: `market/`
## Choose this if

- your project lives in WSL and you want ext4 instead of `/mnt/c`;
- you want one session to stay in
ou are fine with a one-time WSL workspace setup.

If you only need occasional Linux commands from a Windows session, a
`wsl_*` tool plugin is the lowe

r-friction choice. See
the package README.
